pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src/lib/db/credits.test.ts:314 The test's name claims retry idempotency, but the suite stubs withRetry to a single call (fn => fn()), so no retry ever runs. It asserts only that a first-attempt P2002 is swallowed. If the auto:<uuid> key were moved inside the retried closure (one key per attempt), the over-refund defect this test claims to close would come back and the test would stay green.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/db/credits.test.ts:314 The decision being pinned (one idempotency key per invocation, reused across retries) is never reached, because the retry wrapper is stubbed out. The name claims a stronger guard than the assertions make.

src/lib/db/credits.test.ts:17 The client-module mock restates isP2002Error by hand and replaces withRetry with a single call, instead of spreading importOriginal. The fixture forks from the shipped driver on both behaviour and mode (retry).
src/app/api/org/credits/grant/route.test.ts:64 Each of the five mint guards is removed in turn and grantCredits is asserted never called, so each guard's test is proven able to fail.
